title: Cooper launches review of ‘serious failures’ in Alaa Abd el-Fattah case
summary: Foreign secretary says due diligence procedures were inadequate amid storm over activist’s past tweets Yvette Cooper has launched a review looking into “serious information failures” around the case of a British-Egyptian activist welcomed to the UK despite his past tweets now called “abhorrent” by the government. Keir Starmer said he was “delighted” by Alaa Abd el-Fattah’s arrival on Friday but a political storm erupted after social media posts from a decade ago were unearthed including some in which the activist had called for Zionists to be killed.
